original_test_intent: Verify the board's BMC debug UART is electrically and logically usable at 115200 bps, produces intelligible BMC console data, and accepts a bounded harmless keyboard interaction through the correct physical header.
original_method: Identify board/header/pinout and UART voltage; connect an approved receive/transmit/ground adapter without driving power pins; configure approved framing at 115200; capture boot/runtime output with timestamps; enter only an approved harmless command or navigation keystroke; verify echo/response and no platform disturbance; disconnect safely and redact secrets.
manual_activity: Qualified operator connects/disconnects the approved UART adapter and performs bounded keyboard input; agent may analyze the sanitized capture.
required_inputs: Board revision, BMC UART header/designator and RX/TX/GND pinout
Electrical level, isolation and approved USB-UART adapter
115200 framing parameters, flow control and expected console phase/banner
Approved harmless keyboard command/response and secret-redaction policy
safety_requirements: Verify voltage/pinout and never connect adapter power to the board
Use ESD-safe connection in the authorized power state
Do not inject break/bootloader/destructive commands or expose console secrets
Stop on overheating, contention, corrupted output or platform instability
agent_execution_scope: Parse operator-supplied capture for framing/readability and approved response
Redact credentials/tokens and correlate platform logs
Do not attach hardware, guess pins, treat SSH as UART, send privileged input or decide verdict
engineer_actions: Approve connection power state and adapter
Approve harmless control interaction and readable-output oracle
Review evidence and decide PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: No SSH command exercises the physical UART electrical path.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use an approved serial-terminal capture at 115200 with board-specific framing and a single harmless interactive check.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Physical dongle, 115200, readable output and keyboard control remain.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Bind board pinout/voltage and terminal settings to a timestamped sanitized RX capture plus one approved TX interaction.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds electrical safeguards, full framing, exact control oracle and credential handling.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Readable receive-only output does not prove transmit/control, and SSH bypasses the UART path entirely.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Wrong voltage or crossed/powered pins can damage hardware; debug output may expose secrets and break sequences may alter boot.

project_override_considerations: If the header is receive-only or console input is locked by production policy, document the supported limitation instead of forcing keyboard-control coverage.
expected_evidence: Board/header pinout, voltage and adapter identity

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure and Criteria consistently cover physical UART data at 115200 plus keyboard control; missing electrical/framing details are prerequisites.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The test is valid manual work when the function team supplies the pinout and safe procedure.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Functionality row 2267 Wistron-HW-00304-V005: approve board revision and BMC UART header/designator, RX/TX/GND pinout, electrical level/isolation and adapter, safe connection power state, full 115200 framing/flow-control settings and expected banner/output; define one harmless keyboard input and response proving control, production-console access policy, secret redaction and recovery/disconnect criteria.

review_improvement: Preserves physical UART receive/control coverage while preventing guessed wiring, SSH substitution and unsafe or secret-bearing console interaction.
independent_technical_reasoning: Baud rate alone does not define a UART session; voltage, pinout, data bits, parity, stop bits and flow control determine whether output is valid. A receive capture proves only RX, while the Criteria also requires keyboard/TX control. Debug headers may expose bootloaders and credentials, so a board-specific adapter and one pre-approved harmless interaction are necessary. SSH traverses different hardware/software and cannot satisfy this case.
